api: A stateful ledger accepts one-dimensional batches with unique nonempty consignment IDs, nonnegative integer physical endpoint IDs, finite nonnegative sent/delivered kcal (delivered<=sent), explicit integer departure/arrival bins and zero hold only. Arrival must equal (departure+1)%12. Ordered event labels with explicitly allocated nonnegative whole-leg charges annotate one movement; they neither fund additional movements nor derive new times. With no intermediate events the charge is recorded as one whole-leg charge. Reject duplicates across and within calls atomically, invalid shapes/values/bins, nonzero holds, incompatible charge totals and cumulative overdraw. Keep original delivered values exactly, defensively copy receipt arrays and expose no capacity/rights inference.
tolerance: Retain existing grain accounting scale 1e-10*max(1,sent,delivered) for charge-sum/ledger closure only. Endpoint delivered arrays, original direct/intertown arrival reductions and timing require EXACT equality. Do not relax any food/path tolerance or adjust legacy data.
counterexample: Costs25+20 at L100 preserve delivered55 from sent100; multiplying .75*.80 would deliver60. Event partition cannot change55 into60 or shift original arrival.
rejections: charge sum differs from existing whole-leg charge
legacy_reductions: EXACTLY original central and low monthly baseline cases. Source movements preserve physical source order, recorded departures*retention and original per-month bincount reduction; record all valid source rows including zero amounts so ordering is unchanged. Annotate two intermediate events plus terminal charge with allocation .25*charge,.25*charge,remaining charge. Intertown movements preserve recorded shipment order, sent/got values and original per-destination accumulation. Require original direct/inter_received/inter_exported/arrivals arrays exact. Do not invoke routing, food, stock, climate, phenology or population solvers. Record ledger calls and protected/source hashes. An independent reviewer replays reductions without calling the new ledger.
exclusions: No actual warehouse IDs/locations, new routes, physical days, positive hold, storage capacity, rights, workforce allocation, additional Earth food cases, tuning, new fit or atlas/default adoption. Existing route/store outputs remain frozen. Reserved Buringh pools and site-survey workbook unopened; climate/steppe deferred.
